subject: APPROVED (stands) S20 follow-up 707e0be: diagnostics video via PlayerEmbed OK; agent.spec 36/36 on the 4 smoke projects (run 1 had 1 flaky non-S20 offline chunk race); 1 low (error overlay on the player)
body:
Follow-up check of 707e0be (diagnostics video through the player Space bridge). Reviewer: review20. Builds on 20261117T074438-review20-11040b. ## Verdict: APPROVAL STANDS for S20 at 707e0be, still conditional on CI being green for the commit the lead verifies ### Spot-check of 707e0be - apps/web/src/video/PlayerEmbed.tsx reuses the same pieces as the lesson player: `playerUrl(playerOrigin(), location.origin)`, `SANDBOX_ATTR` (allow-scripts allow-same-origin), the same `allow` list and referrer policy, and `connectPlayer` with exact player-origin checks and shape validation. The destroy cleanup is in place. - apps/web/src/agent/AgentDiagnostics.tsx still mounts the player only after the click-to-load facade. There is no longer any direct youtube-nocookie iframe in the app, which matches the parent CSP (`frame-src 'self' `). - Copy comes from existing `ui_copy` keys (video.player_error, video.watch_on_youtube). - agent.spec asserts the player-origin `src` (`/index.html?parent=`) and the sandbox attribute, and still asserts zero iframes before the click. ### Low (non-blocking) 1. **LOW:** PlayerEmbed.tsx, the error `

` is `absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0` over the player frame. It shows only after error/api_failed, but it sits on top of YouTube's own bottom area, where branding and the error screen are. HANDOFF §5.4/§7.1 says no overlay on the player, and the lesson player (YouTubeVideo.tsx) puts the same message below the frame. Suggest rendering it below the 16:9 box instead. 2. **NIT:** agent.spec.ts:158. The "no YouTube contact before the click" request watcher matches youtube/ytimg/googlevideo hosts but not the player Space host. The `iframe` count of 0 before the click covers it in practice; adding the player origin to the watcher would make the intent explicit. ### agent.spec on the 4 smoke projects (local, own fresh -review20 stack: migrated to head, seeded; hosted DB and Space untouched) - `--retries=0 --workers=2` on webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390 and chromium-laptop-1440: - Run 1: 35 passed, 1 failed. - Run 2: **36/36 passed**. - The run 1 failure was `[chromium-laptop-1440] offline: the self-test is disabled and says why`. Seven console `net::ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED` errors for lazily loaded assistant chunks (Streamdown/micromark/KaTeX, from 20241a8 "load on demand") fired after the test went offline. - That is a race between the on-demand chunk load and going offline. It is not S20 and doesn't touch the player. - It passed on rerun, so it's flaky. Flag it to the owner of 20241a8 / agent.spec's offline test (wait for those chunks, or preload them, before `setOffline`). - Web typecheck: pass. Vitest (web): 733 passed. Biome on the changed files: clean.
